text:
morgan: Quick repro for a weird latency spike I hit after the kernel-2.1 rollout. Only happens on mixed-stride synthetic load with prefix caching enabled. Trace + replay attached below.

morgan: Repro steps: 
```bash
# on perf runner
./replay_harness \
  --trace=on \
  --workload=mixed_stride \
  --dist=zipf,alpha=1.1 \
  --prefix-cache=on \
  --kernel=kernel-2.1 \
  --batcher=continuous \
  --warmup=300 \
  --duration=600
```

sasha: Which kernel commit? any kernel flags different from canary? :thinking:

morgan: Commit `a3f5d2c` (kernel-2.1). No special flags, default kernel selector. I compared with kernel-2.0 and the p95 jumps ~18% under 2000rps synthetic run.

jay: ran a quick profile (perf + pprof) on the same run. top nodes:
```
- kernel_selector::select_best 42.3%
- kv_cache::lookup 17.9%
- batcher::emit 12.1%
- rpc_dispatch 9.6%
- evict_thread 3.4%
```
looks like selection code now does heavier checks (fallback compat checks) and serializes something under lock.

lucy: can you try `--stride-prefetch=off` and `--kernel-selector=fast-path`? if it stabilizes, it's selector logic.

morgan: tried that. With `--stride-prefetch=off` p95 drops back to baseline. With `--kernel-selector=fast-path` p50 ok but p95 still flaky.

morgan: captured small log excerpt where eviction and request path contend:
```
[12:02:14.345] kv_cache: lookup prefix=usr:doc:abcd found=false
[12:02:14.345] evict: evicting prefix=usr:doc:abcd lock=held
[12:02:14.346] kv_cache: insert prefix=usr:doc:abcd lock=blocked
[12:02:14.347] kv_cache: warning: delayed insert after eviction
```

sasha: hmm looks like a warmup imbalance — eviction bursts during warmup create miss storms. Could be amplified by stride prefetcher kicking in and creating extra candidate prefixes.

perf-bot: automated regression check: benchmark/mixed_stride/2000rps vs kernel-2.0 -> kernel-2.1: p95 +18%, p99 +27%, cpu +12% :eyes:

morgan: plan: (1) add lightweight prefetch debounce during warmup, (2) add eviction backoff, (3) add selector fast-path gate for common model shapes. I'll push a small patch and run apples-to-apples with replay harness.

jay: also add a micro-benchmark for prefix cache hot-path with concurrent insert/evict to catch races; include TSan.

lucy: assign me for canary monitoring. I'll set dashboards to alert if p95 > baseline +10% for next rollout.

morgan: thanks — I'll drop the reproducer and traces into the perf bucket: gs://redwood-perf/repro/1755550001/

sasha: thanks, looks actionable. :thumbsup:
